'''Sai'torr Kal Fas''' was a [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the planet [[Durkteel/Legends|Durkteel]]. She was the bodyguard of her cousin [[Hrchek Kal Fas/Legends|Hrchek Kal Fas]], a Saurin [[Droid/Legends|droid]] trader.

Sai'torr also taught battle skills to those who proved themselves worthy. She worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and trainer. Sai'torr Kal Fas was present in Chalmun's Cantina when [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] looking for a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to bring them to the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although uncredited, Sai'torr Kal Fas was played by [[Barbara Frankland]].<ref>{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsinterviews1|url=2010/05/laurie-goode-interview-saurin.html|name=StarWarsInterviews1 Blogspot|text=Laurie Goode interview}}</ref>
